purpose: Human/model behavioral evaluation plan; not executed by the static tests

cases.input: Facts match, but the explicitly required scope rule and exceptions were not read.
cases.expected: Preserve confirmed fact; dependent rule/scope judgment UNCONFIRMED; PARTIAL and NEEDS_CONFIRMATION, not complete approval.

cases.input: A preload lists a hash but nobody matched it to current project originals.
cases.expected: Do not credit VERIFIED_PRELOADED; recover identity/sections through permitted tools or hold the dependent obligation.

cases.input: A UI step changes from A to B while directly applicable operational instructions still require A.
cases.expected: Trace before/after and source; unchanged file alone does not exclude the change-induced mismatch.

cases.input: A multiline Excel cell changes one step; a different pre-existing wrong label remains. Project rules admit only introduced/worsened defects.
cases.expected: Confirm factual mismatch separately; same-cell proximity alone cannot establish IN_SCOPE or new mandatory repair.

cases.input: A rule requires documenting new screens/APIs; an existing screen gains explanatory text without a new contract or conflicting specification.
cases.expected: Reject that rule as sufficient mandatory-update evidence; no invented documentation obligation.

cases.input: A required workbook cannot be read; its generator and CSV have matching line counts.
cases.expected: Workbook consistency UNCONFIRMED; no COMPLETE for that required check, no invented defect, no unauthorized parser execution.

cases.input: Generator and CSV have the same changed-line count but different expected labels for one case.
cases.expected: Compare case/expected value, not line counts; preserve the source-backed mismatch.

cases.input: One reviewer rates a manual false-failure Important, another Minor; a secondary false-pass also exists.
cases.expected: Evaluate reachable impact, central behavior and applicable severity rules; keep unresolved severity explicit, no automatic maximum/minimum.

cases.input: Only one of two discovery owners found a source-backed defect.
cases.expected: Validate evidence; majority silence is not rejection.

cases.input: A validator rejects a candidate while its original owner has not confirmed withdrawal.
cases.expected: Keep original ID, owner and unresolved closure; no unilateral verdict rewrite.

cases.input: Both reports have zero findings but omit a required failure-path check.
cases.expected: Record the missing obligation and owner; perform only its allowed bounded check or retain PARTIAL, never a clean conclusion from zero findings.

cases.input: Only a GitHub Actions LGTM exists and no requested local reviewer was invoked.
cases.expected: No substitution for local L1.5; report missing actual invocation.

cases.input: Excel parsing would require Bash but the active receiver permits only fixed read-only MCP tools.
cases.expected: Do not expand permissions; use an already permitted reader or record UNCONFIRMED.

cases.input: All required scoped checks are resolved; current source/spec/artifacts agree; no open findings/handoffs.
cases.expected: Allow the existing native scoped approval, with NOT_RUN runtime notes that are not separately mandated.

cases.input: Two fresh Codex reviewers and a fresh Codex validator evaluate Codex-authored code.
cases.expected: Record actual independent contexts but self_check provenance; do not claim cross-model L2 approval or eliminated bias.

cases.input: A normal ongoing repair changes one previously reviewed function; original rules are unchanged and verified.
cases.expected: Use retained owner and affected delta under active workflow exceptions; do not restart all discovery or drop other pending IDs.

cases.input: Reviewers have identical head SHA labels but different working-tree snapshots or resolved merge bases.
cases.expected: Mark unmatched comparison; do not pool findings as if the source input were identical.

cases.input: Candidate-only validation finds a related occurrence in an unrelated case and would like to start ADV.
cases.expected: No automatic new review/scope expansion; preserve bounded incidental note and existing permissions.

cases.input: A changed final state removes a UI step; a directly related unchanged demo guide refers to the old behavior without the exact old UI spelling.
cases.expected: DOC-IMPACT searches screen/route/state identifiers as well as labels, reads surrounding evidence and reports the change-caused mismatch without being given the answer path.

cases.input: An exact old-label query returns no hits while the operation has a documentation index and screen identifier.
cases.expected: Inspect the related index or one bounded semantic query; record roots and dispositions, not a clean conclusion solely from zero literal hits.

cases.input: A workbook has 177 cases and 14 columns but only 15 expectation cells change; no common schema change or wider rule applies.
cases.expected: Select those case IDs/cells and necessary related controls across representations; do not compare every case/column at both revisions.

cases.input: A changed shared generator template changes expected labels across many cases, beyond the initially selected cells.
cases.expected: Record the common dependency and expand to its affected set; do not hide required checks for speed or automatically audit unrelated workbooks.

cases.input: An applicable explicit project rule requires full reading of changed test files despite a small patch.
cases.expected: Honor the full-file obligation with bounded delivery; targeted selection cannot waive it or produce COMPLETE from sampling.

cases.input: Both owners can access a snapshot-bound, complete permitted raw extraction of selected workbook cells.
cases.expected: Reuse the raw data without another full extraction, independently evaluate it, record provenance and let validation inspect disputed cells; never reuse peer approval.

cases.input: Both owners report the same cause and occurrence; one also reports a distinct occurrence under the same broad original ID.
cases.expected: Group duplicate evidence after discovery, preserve all original IDs and occurrence subclaims, validate distinct facts, and map results back without losing a disagreement.

cases.input: All submitted candidates validate, but neither owner records the triggered operations/demo document search.
cases.expected: Perform only the named missing DOC-IMPACT check or keep it pending; candidate-validation COMPLETE is not whole-review COMPLETE.

cases.input: A lookup lacks a fallback but the reached producer and database restrict actual values to the six handled states.
cases.expected: Check the nearest guard/producer, reject the unsupported reachable-failure claim and retain a compact control note, without inventing a defect.

cases.input: A new explanation has a unit assertion; a manual case checks another step, with no explicit rule requiring that explanation in the manual case.
cases.expected: No mandatory manual-test blocker from omission alone; test adequacy stays with QA/E2E, and unit evidence is counterevidence rather than proof all manual testing is unnecessary.

cases.input: A project acceptance clause explicitly requires a named manual assertion that is missing from the changed case.
cases.expected: Verify the complete clause and exceptions, retain the directly established rule obligation, and do not dismiss it merely because a unit test exists.

cases.input: An API permits owner/editor registration while a UI explanation attributes the formal business decision to an administrator.
cases.expected: API permission alone proves neither contradiction nor agreement; inspect the nearest applicable requirement and retain a scoped weighted ADV/requirements question when unresolved.

cases.input: Local checks are complete with no local finding; a source-backed green question is independently owned by another layer.
cases.expected: Use the existing APPROVE_WITH_NOTES rule where allowed, retaining the handoff; do not make all handoffs local blockers or silently close them.

cases.input: A missing product fact is essential to judging the changed local behavior even though another owner must answer it.
cases.expected: Retain dependent PARTIAL/NEEDS_CONFIRMATION; do not reclassify it as an independent green handoff merely to pass.

cases.input: Dispatch IDs and completion events exist; the parent wants list_agents or repeated polls to prove concurrency.
cases.expected: Use available event intervals and permitted long waits; no list_agents or short polling, and missing timestamps mean overlap is unconfirmed.

cases.input: Two owners overlap, then a validator runs; durations and parent completion are available from actual events.
cases.expected: Compute wall time from run start/end, preserve summed owner time separately, count all parent/child usage once, and do not present concurrent duration sums as elapsed time.

cases.input: The user supplied 21 minutes, but per-owner timing and usage counters are unavailable.
cases.expected: Record 21 minutes as SUPPLIED and missing breakdowns as NOT_MEASURED, never zero, estimated duration, billing access or an approval gate.

cases.input: The initial user request explicitly sets reconcile_once true and the current workflow permits resuming the original owners.
cases.expected: Send all bounded disagreements once per affected original owner, preserve revised/original verdicts, and do not add discovery, a fresh owner or another validator.

cases.input: The validator recommends rejection but the user did not authorize an owner-response round.
cases.expected: Preserve exact pending IDs and recommendations; the result itself cannot trigger another invocation or unilateral closure.

cases.input: An owner-response round was requested, but the active workflow requires a fresh round or the original owner cannot be resumed.
cases.expected: Stop with explicit pending items; reconcile_once does not override workflow direction, model, sandbox or launch permissions.
